en.headline: Man, 66, arrested over HK$210,000 of drugs at Chuk Yuen South
en.dek: Police seized suspected cocaine and ice from a man and a flat at Sau Yuen House; he is due in Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday.
body: A 66-year-old local man was arrested on Monday night on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs after police seized suspected cocaine and ice worth more than HK$210,000 at Chuk Yuen South Estate in Wong Tai Sin.

Sau Mau Ping District special duties officers said they acted on information at about 9.30pm. They stopped the man outside Sau Yuen House and found about 64 grams of suspected cocaine on him. In a flat in the same block they seized about 138 grams of suspected cocaine, 8 grams of suspected ice and packaging items, police said.
The man was detained for inquiries. Police said he would face two counts of trafficking in dangerous drugs and was due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday morning.
Police reiterated that trafficking in dangerous drugs is a serious offence that can carry a maximum penalty of life imprisonment and a HK$5 million fine.

zh.headline: 竹園南部檢值21萬毒品 66歲男子涉販毒被捕
zh.dek: 秀茂坪警區人員周一晚在秀園樓外及單位內檢獲懸疑可卡因及冰毒，案件周三早上在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
body: 一名66歲本地男子星期一晚在黃大仙竹園南部涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕，警方檢獲市值逾21萬元的懸疑可卡因及冰毒。
秀茂坪警區特別職務隊表示，根據線報於晚上約9時30分在竹園南部一帶行動，在秀園樓外截查該名男子，在他身上檢獲約64克懸疑可卡因，其後在同一座一個單位內再檢獲約138克懸疑可卡因、8克懸疑冰毒及一批懸疑包裝工具。
該名男子現正被扣留調查。警方指他將被暫控兩項販運危險藥物罪，案件星期三上午在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
警方重申，販毒屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可判終身監禁及罰款500萬元。
